name: Piano lessons
summary: How expats arrange piano lessons in Singapore — home vs studio teachers, graded exam tracks, digital piano condo compromises, and practice-hour etiquette.
body:
Piano teachers offer classical graded paths, pop/jazz tracks, and adult beginner programmes. Condos often push families toward weighted digital pianos with headphone practice to keep neighbours sane.

## Formats
- 1:1 home visits
- Studio lessons with acoustic pianos
- Graded exam preparation
- Adult beginner evening slots
- Online lessons when one parent travels

Clarify acoustic vs digital instrument expectations early.

## How to choose
Prefer teachers who hear a placement piece and set a realistic practice plan. Ask about exam fees versus lesson fees. Confirm makeup-lesson policies around school holidays.

## Practical tip
Agree quiet-hour practice windows with neighbours before buying an acoustic upright. Headphones on a digital piano buy goodwill you cannot repurchase later.
